cost.details: Expend Beastshift charges (0.2: Direbeast Form uses) to upcast Sporesphere

system.description:
You can expend Beastshift charges to upcast your spores. Each charge expended can either increase the damage die size or add the Blinded or Poisoned condition.

Nimble 0.2 playtest rules (world setting on): the Stormshifter has no Beastshift charges; spend Direbeast Form uses (DEX/encounter) instead.

[A] While you own this feature, the Sporesphere dialog offers a Decay panel: enter the number of die-size bumps and tick Blinded / Poisoned. With the 0.2 rules on, the macro spends that many uses from the Direbeast Form pool and blocks the cast if too few are left; correct a wrong spend with the counter's +/- on the sheet.

[M] With the 0.2 rules off (Heroes 2.0.3), Beastshift charges are tracked by hand; the chat card records the spend.
